operationCatalogue.summary: Compose bounded typed scientific derivation paths into proposal-only candidates with explicit assumptions,losses,evidence and rejection receipts. No entailment,empirical authority,corpus admission or application activation.
Read a host-resolved local context at an exact state and interpretation. Does not grant authority or start services.
Prepare an algebra-first work commit using one exact immutable-snapshot,hash-bound prior capability observation. No application activation,deployment or business authority.
Legacy bounded inert-JSON preparation session. Use v2 for status,cancel and explicit limits.

Stage,inspect or cancel bounded inert JSON chunks by exact sequence and hash,then invoke observed algebra preparation after exact aggregate reassembly. Send at most 100000 characters per append;status never returns staged payload bytes. No supplied code execution or application authority.
Load the fixed SQLite-backed Claimipedia project declarations and inspect authored contexts using existing owners. Read-only; not application runtime extension loading or admission.
Read the fixed SQLite-captured Claimipedia operator corpus with exact source identity. Not a live application, public projection, mutation or admission.
Owned SQLite-backed application read projection lifecycle. Explicit captured sources and resource limits;no business mutation or application-author grant.
Inspect, initialize, prepare, admit and select exact reader-registry successors in SQLite. Does not activate a runtime or grant business authority.
Start, inspect, stop or select an exact SQLite-published work context. Selection grants no product activation or new authority.

Return the current Sourcery MCP surface and connection interaction context. List returns filters and pagination immediately; select binds a workspace for subsequent Status. Context selection does not acquire a writer lease.
Legacy governed create-only runtime installation and qualification. Use temple_runtime_package_v2 for bounded resumable authoring. No activation or launcher modification.

Governed create-only runtime installation,qualification and resumable work preparation. prepare-session requires phase and session;status and cancel are bounded lifecycle actions. Exact SQLite package,discovery,review and installation admission required. No activation or launcher modification.

Governed create-only runtime installation,qualification and resumable work preparation. Phase-specific session arguments are schema-visible;status and cancel are bounded lifecycle actions. No activation or launcher modification.
Inspect or explicitly admit a changed inactive runtime-package review. Signed expiring eligibility only;no installation,activation or business authority.
Atomically activate an admitted generation after rechecking its exact bytes and baseline schema.
Sign an explicit bounded admission for a passing check against the current generation.
Execute protected-runtime, transport and baseline-schema checks for a staged generation.
Describe the active fossil/runtime generation, retained transition evidence, compact workflows and operation catalogue.
Describe any operation in the active worker catalog, including successor-only operations.
Execute an operation from the active worker catalog through the stable extension surface.
Return version-bound, read-only help for a Temple topic, operation or current lane context.
Create a signed recovery transition to the predecessor retained by an activation.
Stage a named generation from the supervisor-controlled manifest directory.
Logically archive a closed lane with a terminal disposition; bytes are not deleted.
Bless the exact tested head of an integration lane.
Create a registered sparse editor projection inside the manager-controlled lane directory.
Release one lane lease without an implicit commit.
Commit explicit changes to an open lane head.
Discard a registered editor projection and delete its disposable files without committing.
Create a thin task lane from the exact blessed snapshot of a closed integration lane.
Renew an open lane writer lease.
Commit the exact delta from a disposable projection.
List registered lanes without opening their overlay databases for writing.
List files in one open lane snapshot.
Create a disposable native projection for a filesystem-only tool.
Merge a proposal from a registered source lane into an open integration lane.
Create a fenced verified parallel successor lane on a new exact base without changing the source lane or reusing its snapshot identities.

Upload an exact workspace object in bounded hash-verified chunks or read it by bounded byte range. Each action declares its required arguments;object references are lane-and-snapshot bound and grant no authority.
Create or reopen a named task or integration lane and acquire its writer lease.
Apply algebra-prepared workspace changes as ordered,hash-bound,restart-safe segments. Phase-specific session arguments are schema-visible;commits occur once at finalize and responses remain compact.

Apply algebra-prepared workspace changes through bounded segments while binding a large capability prior by exact immutable workspace reference. Prior bytes are verified internally and never cross the MCP request envelope;old preparation contracts remain unchanged.
List registered editor projections and their durable disposition.
Propose the exact tested head of a task lane.
Propose an exact tested task head with canonical artifact lineage and intended endpoints.
Read one file from an open lane composed view.
Ingest the exact declared scope of a registered editor projection and delete its disposable files.
Compose a blessed integration lane into a successor Temple package.
Inspect one registered lane and its durable head/lease state.
Describe the exclusive writer ownership of one task lane without locking files or artifacts.
Run a bounded Node test in a disposable full, test-file or declared-closure projection and advance the lane head to its scope-bound receipt snapshot.
Run a bounded Node test in an explicitly selected disposable full, test-file or declared-closure projection and advance the lane head to its scope-bound telemetry receipt.

algebraFirst.scope: All Sourcery representation migrations use exact evidence. Static capabilities remain predecessors;new mature boundary capabilities enter through exact package-local declaration,qualification,grammar,phase,port,adapter and evidence closure.
algebraFirst.legacyCode: compatibility-only;unchanged use or deletion;extensions enter grammar

packageLocalCapabilities.extensionRule: new phases are package-local grammar data;new mechanisms remain explicit mature adapters
